<section class="home-intro" aria-label="Profile">
  <h2>Seokju Kang</h2>

  <figure class="profile-card">
    <img src="assets/profile.jpeg" alt="Seokju Kang" />
  </figure>

  <p>I am currently a Ph.D. candidate in Management Engineering at UNIST, advised by Prof. Hyun Jin Jang. Prior to that, I received my B.S. in Industrial Engineering from Pusan National University in February 2024.</p>

  <p>My research domain is in <strong>Financial Engineering</strong>, with a particular emphasis on risk management, derivatives pricing, and quantitative finance. I am also working on <strong>AI/OR applications in finance</strong>.</p>
